title: Contact-not-found in outbox retries 72x before permanent failure
description: outbox_tick contact lookup: Ok(None) (contact deleted from store) calls record_failure, burning retry budget over hours before mark_failed. Contact not existing is not transient; the row will not reappear. Trigger: user removes a contact while an outbox message to them is pending. Fix: Ok(None) should call mark_failed immediately (unlike Ok(false)/blocked which should suspend, not fail).
